messages:
maria_chen: Proposal — add a new rollout guard 'cost_and_latency' that can auto-pause canaries when cost or latency or error SLOs breach. Sketch below, open to bikeshedding.

```yaml
rollout_guards:
  - name: cost_and_latency
    window: 5m
    checks:
      - type: estimated_token_cost
        threshold_per_minute: 0.004   # USD/token (normalized)
        token_budget: 10000
      - type: p95_latency_ms
        threshold: 1000
      - type: error_rate
        threshold: 0.01
    action: pause
    notify: [slack#eng-platform, pagerduty]
    dry_run: true
```

maria_chen: Rationale: combine cost and SLO checks so we don't burn credits during bad model rollouts. dry_run true by default so ops can review first. Also propose a `fallback_model` option to route traffic to cheaper model on pause.

alex_r: Quick notes — cost calc is tricky: depends on batching, model quantization, and route-level tokenization. We should normalize by an `effective_token_cost(model_variant)` rather than raw per-token TODO. Also worried about overlapping with existing `slo_check` guard.

samir: We need telemetry if we're going to pause automatically. Propose adding a meter `rollout.estimated_cost` and a trace tag `rollout.token_count`. Sampling: 1/10 by default, ramp as canary traffic grows. I can draft the metrics PR.

jess_leung: Console UX: defaults should be conservative. dry_run=true in config, and UI shows a visual "projected cost delta" before enabling auto-pause. Also add an explicit "why paused" timeline item (which check fired + last 3 datapoints).

deploy-bot: deploy: rollout-config updated for service/api by maria_chen at 1855012345 :white_check_mark:

infra-monitor: Alert (canary #42): p95=1200ms (threshold 1000ms), estimated_cost spike 2.3x, error_rate=0.012 -> auto-pause triggered (dry_run=false). See /ops/rollouts/42

maria_chen: Thanks — good call on normalization @alex_r. Plan: I'll add `effective_token_cost` map keyed by model variant and quantization, then update the YAML. Also will include `fallback_model` + explicit reason string for UI.

alex_r: I'll take the telemetry PR @samir if you want to pair. We'll add normalized cost metric and a lightweight aggregator to avoid double-counting with batching.

jess_leung: I'll mock the wireframes tomorrow — will include an affordance to turn off auto-pause per-environment and a dry-run toggle. Also will add a hover tooltip explaining how cost is estimated.

maria_chen: Sounds good. I'll open the config PR after Alex/Samir confirm metric names. tagging @eng-oncall so they're aware of the potential auto-pause behavior. :+1:
